lines.text: Herod hears people say Jesus is John the Baptist risen from the dead, whom he had beheaded.
Herod had John arrested and imprisoned because John said it was not lawful to have his brother Philip's wife Herodias.
Herodias wanted John dead, but she could not, because John's disciples guarded the prison and protected him.

wrong_details.wrong: John's disciples guarded the prison and protected him
wrong_details.true: Herod feared John and protected him

lines.text: At Herod's birthday banquet, the daughter of Herodias pleased him by dancing, and he swore to give her up to half his kingdom; she asked her father.
The girl asked for John's head on a platter, Herod sent an executioner, and John's disciples placed his body in a tomb.
